passage:
A brown dog came to the school gate every afternoon. It did not bark or enter the school. It only sat and watched students leave.
Some students gave it food, but the guard told them not to. "If it belongs to someone, we should find the owner," he said.
A teacher took a photo and posted it on the community board. Two days later, an old woman came to the school. The dog ran to her happily.
She explained that the dog had followed her grandson to school once and remembered the place. After that, it came back every day, waiting.
The students were happy the dog found its family. They also learned that kindness needs thought. Feeding an animal is easy, but helping it go home is better.
